'''113 Kantal Boulevard''' was a building that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nek Lawsirk]] lived in [[Apartment 8|Apartment #8]] of this building.<ref name="LF" />
